viewing_check: Look through the f-hole with a torch or phone camera for a paper label or ink stamp (maker, place, date) and photograph it; check the neck/scroll for a brand burn mark or branded back; check for cracks, open seams, soundpost crack and top repairs; photograph the bow frog, stick and any stamp (silver, nickel, pernambuco vs brazilwood), and check the bow is straight with hair. Measure body length (about 356 mm for 4/4).
